obligations.text: IPM refuses an install when no repository is enabled in the namespace.

obligations.text: IPM refuses an install when the module or the requested version is not found in any repository.
obligations.cases: missing module; offered module but missing version; missing qualifier repository
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: Only a missing qualifier repository (iter18) and an empty search after deletion (iter22) are modeled; iter31 Outcome.msg_none is never exercised. Contrast: install B 9.9.9 with B offered only at 1.0.0 refuses with the not-found message and leaves the namespace unchanged.

obligations.text: IPM downloads the package, unpacks it into <ModuleRoot>/<name>/<version>/ and loads the module from there.
obligations.cases: registry install vs filesystem repository install
obligations.observation: module root of the installed module
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: No model of Utils/Module.cls::LoadModuleFromArchive extraction path or of the ModuleRoot layout (iter19 duplicates.rs and iter22 cover filesystem repositories, which install from the repository folder). Contrast: a remote/ORAS install has Root <ModuleRoot>/<name>/<version>/ with the extracted manifest; the existing folder replaced before any version check.
